lineage.description: Building footprints were extracted from OpenStreetMap volunteered geographic information and processed through the HOT raw data API. The dataset represents approximately 40% of estimated total buildings based on AI-mapped estimates, with an average data age of 2 years and 3% of buildings added or updated in the last 6 months. Data is provided in multiple geospatial formats (SHP, KML, GeoJSON, Geopackage) for accessibility.
